name: size-pinned

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan

description: A pinned target answers every size request `pinned` (C2 decision 8; 5.50; D36): the target's floor equals its ceiling, so its size is fixed. The session record advertises pinned: true and resizable: still true — the protocol has a size, it just cannot change. The answer carries the size that stands. The live shape is graded by U2 (owed by the E2 core plan).

instances.note: floor = ceiling: the request is answered with the fixed size
reason is one of the six; a pinned target says pinned
cols and rows are both required
